cases.question: Покажи как меняется степень набухания мембраны Нафион пре переходе от протонированной к литированной форме
requirements: Compare protonated and lithiated Nafion swelling for matched source-supported media and conditions.
Preserve definition/units of swelling; do not conflate mass gain, mass ratio or volume swelling.
Do not assert a universal increase/decrease from a limited solvent set.

cases.question: Какая смесь растворителей даёт наилучшую ионную проводимость для Li-Nafion
requirements: Identify the mixture and its composition/basis, conductivity/unit and temperature when reported.
Do not substitute the best individual solvent or an unrelated membrane/conductivity type.
State the tested comparison set; do not infer a global literature optimum.

cases.question: Какие существуют методики литирования Nafion?
requirements: Separate distinct source-supported lithiation/ion-exchange protocols by work and starting material.
Retain reagent, medium, concentration, temperature, duration, washing/drying and endpoints only where linked in source.
Do not count cleaning/protonation as lithium exchange or claim an exhaustive literature catalogue.
known_topic_overlap: Experimental source contexts have been exposed in prior cleaning/protonation/operation pilots; no unseen-source claim.
